newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan weekly forex reserves up at $1.377 bln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan weekly forex reserves up at $1.377 bln.

text.p: Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves rose slightly up to $1.377 billion on November 21, from $1.354 billion a week earlier, but lower when compared to $1,762 billion on November 23, 1995, the State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Tuesday.
The central bank gave no reason for the rise.
The reserves included $460 million within Pakistan and $237 million outside Pakistan, the bank said.
